scope: Mandatory detailed art/UI and extensibility planning plus bounded source critique for native single-author generation

python.skips: 7 PostgreSQL-only cases and 15 opt-in Docker/browser cases

checks.browser: Authenticated historical version shows the new design section, its saved short direction, absent detailed design/review, and no invented quality pass. Original user tab kept intact.
checks.deployment: Idle native generator restarted and studio reloaded; original game, other worker and historical reports retained

covered_invariants: New plans cannot omit art/UI or maintainability design
Historical plans remain readable; old revisions receive new planning without widening file capabilities
Review requires all seven criteria and exact source citations
Rejected unchanged source never gets a candidate or another paid review
Modified source gets a new hash-bound critique
Persistent findings stop after at most three reviews
Worker integration accounts for the added call and reuses all completed receipts after restart
baseline_preservation: Original user prompt, spec, plan, provenance and model/budget settings saved privately. All four original model request payloads reconstructed and matched against durable SHA-256 fingerprints without paid inference.
limitations: No new live generation was requested or run for this patch. New artwork has not been visually evaluated.
Critique is based on source; rendered_visual_review is explicitly not_performed. Browser functional validation remains separate.
Four-author historical comparison mode retains its original strategy.
Existing total time, dollar, operation and source-size limits still apply; exceeding them stops the attempt instead of reducing scope.
